characters.name: Paddington
characters.description: A small, polite bear from Peru who travels to London and is taken in by the kind Brown family.

characters.name: Mary Brown
characters.description: A warm-hearted mother who welcomes Paddington into her home and treats him like one of her own children.

characters.name: Henry Brown
characters.description: Mary's cautious husband who slowly warms up to Paddington and helps him find a home.

characters.name: Judy Brown
characters.description: The Brown family's teenage daughter who becomes one of Paddington's best friends in London.

translations.title: Paddington (2014)
translations.description: A young bear from darkest Peru travels to London hoping to find a new home, and is welcomed by the friendly Brown family who help him on his adventure.
translations.history: Paddington Bear was created by British author Michael Bond, who first got the idea after seeing a lonely toy bear on a shop shelf on Christmas Eve!

translations.title: Gấu Paddington (2014)
translations.description: Một chú gấu nhỏ từ rừng già Peru đi đến London để tìm nhà mới, và được gia đình Brown thân thiện đón nhận giúp đỡ chú trong cuộc phiêu lưu.
translations.history: Gấu Paddington được tác giả người Anh Michael Bond sáng tạo, ông nghĩ ra ý tưởng này sau khi nhìn thấy một con gấu bông cô đơn trên giá hàng vào đêm Giáng Sinh!
